name: Default
shortDescription: Lightning Network node on Bitcoin mainnet using the built-in Neutrino light client, with an auto-created wallet and the REST API served over HTTPS.

alerts.message: The wallet seed is generated on first start and saved to /root/.lnd/seed.txt. Open a terminal in the lnd container, run cat /root/.lnd/seed.txt, back up the 24 words offline, then delete the file. Without the seed, funds cannot be recovered if the volume is lost; channel funds also need a recent copy of data/chain/bitcoin/mainnet/channel.backup.

Every REST call needs a macaroon. Use lncli in the lnd container terminal, and bake a scoped macaroon for remote clients with lncli bakemacaroon. Only the REST API is routed; peers cannot open inbound connections on port 9735, so this node opens channels outbound only.
